entities.title: Browser game
entities.summary: Everything that runs in the player's browser: the engine, the UI and the page's loop.
entities.purpose: Wires the engine to the page in main.ts: sixty steps a second whatever the screen's refresh rate, a frame drawn at the screen's own resolution, the sounds, the best score and the sound setting kept in the browser, the demo when the title screen is left alone, and a pause when the tab is hidden.
boundaries: The rules live in engine/; drawing, controls and sound in ui/. main.ts holds no rule of the game.
Talks to no server: the page makes no request of its own once its files are loaded, and what it keeps, it keeps in the browser's localStorage.
Bundled by build.mjs into one game.js; who may load it is the Worker's business (games/lundey/worker).
